instruction: Can you disable the feature that sends usage statistics to Google from Chrome?

metadata.explanation: Task requires agent to disable usage statistics and crash reports in Chrome settings. The getter reads Chrome Preferences to verify metrics.reporting is false or not present.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic has incorrect default value for Chrome preference key
The getter defaults 'reporting_enabled' to True when key is absent (line 36), but Chrome typically removes this key when metrics are disabled
This causes false negatives: when user successfully disables metrics (key absent), getter returns 'false' instead of 'true', failing verification
Metadata claims 'metrics.reporting is false or not present' should pass, but code logic contradicts this by treating 'not present' as enabled
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Change line 36 default from True to False: data.get('user_experience_metrics', {}).get('reporting_enabled', False)
This will correctly treat absent key as disabled (metrics_enabled = False), returning 'true' as expected
